Normalized Heritage (RFI v1.0). Ported to Roll for Initiation: 7-damage-type canon, Soma Break, Tier-based scaling, reroll-lowest. Replaces the D&D5E heritage draft dated 2026-04-19 00:10.

“Stone doesn’t hurry. You don’t either.”

Echo-Diver (Tellurian). You tune to the long stone — the stasis register, what endures, what outlasts. Your precognition is slow and sure: not the lightning, the bedrock.

Heritage Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Echo-Diver).
  • Size. Medium. Speed: normal.
  • Bedrock Stance. You cannot be subject to forced movement, and you cannot be made prone while conscious. (Narrative until Phase 3 condition engine lands — GM enforces.)
  • Stone Patience (stasis-sense). By touch you know the approximate age and structural integrity of any object, surface, or Menhirkin-adjacent creature.
  • Slow Blood. Reroll the lowest die on checks to maintain a sustained Manifestation while taking damage. You do not age naturally while conscious.
  • Signature. You gain Stone Patience at character creation.

Engine note. Where this heritage grants a damage-type resistance, it is applied by the fourththing defense engine via flags.fourththing.grants. Narrative immunities (sleep, forced movement, cold iron) are descriptive only until the Phase 3 condition-and-flavor engine ships.

advancement.hint: Gain the Echo-Diver (Tellurian) signature feat: Stone Patience.
